ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: SparkyFitness needs access to your camera to scan food barcodes and labels.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: SparkyFitness reads Health data (such as activity, workouts, and body measurements) to display it in the app and sync it to your self-hosted SparkyFitness server.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: SparkyFitness writes the nutrition and hydration you log in the app to Apple Health, keeping the two in sync.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SparkyFitness connects to self-hosted servers on your local network.
